validate_program: validate a RASP program to check if it can be compiled by Tracr with optional input sequence
static_validate_program: statically validate a RASP program to detect unsupported expressions without execution
dynamic_validate_program: dynamically validate a RASP program against an input sequence to catch runtime unsupported aggregates
create_tracr_unsupported_expr: create a TracrUnsupportedExpr dataclass instance to represent an uncompilable RASP expression and its reason
build_dynamic_validation_evaluator: build a DynamicValidationEvaluator to evaluate RASP programs and collect unsupported aggregate expressions at runtime
